class.name: LandscapeFoliage3D
class.brief_description: Foliage (trees, bushes, grass, rocks...) painted on a [Landscape3D].
class.description: Instances of [LandscapeFoliageType]s placed on the terrain of a [Landscape3D] ancestor, similar to foliage in Unreal Engine. In the editor, they are painted in the Foliage tab of the Landscape dock (paint, erase, single instance, reapply, fill), with undo and redo. Instances are stored in the space of the landscape and sorted into square cells ([member chunk_size]): - each cell is drawn with one [MultiMesh] per level of detail, with the bounds of the cell, so cells are frustum and occlusion culled independently; - the level of detail of each instance is chosen from its distance to the camera of the landscape (see [member Landscape3D.lod_camera_path]). Cells entirely within one level are drawn with that level as a whole and aren't updated until they leave it; cells crossing a level or cull distance are sorted per instance, with hysteresis ([member LandscapeFoliageType.lod_transition]), and only the levels whose instances changed are uploaded; - cells beyond the cull distance have no rendering resources; the updates are limited to a time budget per frame, nearest cells first. The per-instance random value [code]INSTANCE_CUSTOM.x[/code] (between [code]0[/code] and [code]1[/code]) can be used by shaders for variations. When the terrain is sculpted (in the editor or at runtime), instances follow it ([member follow_terrain]). [b]Note:[/b] The transform of this node is ignored: instances are placed in the space of the landscape and move with it.

method.name: add_foliage_type
method.description: Adds a foliage type without instances and returns its index.

method.name: add_instance
method.description: Adds an instance of the type [param type_index] with a global transform. It keeps its height above the ground when the terrain changes.

method.name: add_instances
method.description: Adds instances of the type [param type_index] with global transforms.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all instances of the type [param type_index] (of all types when negative).

method.name: erase
method.description: Removes random instances of the type [param type_index] in a horizontal circle (global center, radius in meters) until [param density_scale] times the density of the type is left in it ([code]0[/code]: all of them). A negative type index erases every type. Returns the number of removed instances.

method.name: estimate_fill_count
method.description: Returns the number of instances [method fill] would place on the whole landscape without filters (the density of the type times the area of the landscape).

method.name: fill
method.description: Places the type [param type_index] everywhere its filters allow it, at its density, in a rect of the landscape space (the whole landscape when empty). Existing instances count towards the density. Returns the number of new instances.

method.name: find_foliage_type
method.description: Returns the index of a foliage type, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: force_update
method.description: Rebuilds the rendering of all cells.

method.name: get_foliage_type
method.description: Returns the foliage type at [param index].

method.name: get_foliage_type_count
method.description: Returns the number of foliage types.

method.name: get_instance_count
method.description: Returns the number of instances of the type [param type_index] (of all types when negative).

method.name: get_instance_transforms
method.description: Returns the global transforms of the instances of the type [param type_index], optionally only those inside a global [AABB].

method.name: get_instances_in_radius
method.description: Returns the global transforms of the instances of the type [param type_index] in a horizontal circle.

method.name: get_instances_in_rect
method.description: Returns the instances of the type [param type_index] in a rect of the landscape space, as raw data ([constant INSTANCE_FLOATS] floats per instance). Used by the undo and redo of the editor tools, with [method set_instances_in_rect].

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns statistics about the instances and their rendering: [code]types[/code], [code]instances[/code], [code]cells[/code], [code]cells_rendered[/code] (cells with rendering resources), [code]cells_mixed[/code] (cells sorted per instance), [code]batches[/code] (drawn multimeshes), [code]instances_drawn[/code], [code]update_usec[/code] and [code]updated_cells[/code] (last update of the levels of detail), [code]debug_bounds[/code] (cells whose bounds are drawn by [member debug_view]).

method.name: get_type_data
method.description: Returns the instances of the type [param type_index] compressed, as stored in [member instance_data].

method.name: move_foliage_type
method.description: Moves the foliage type at index [param from] (with its instances) to index [param to].

method.name: paint
method.description: Adds instances of the type [param type_index] in a horizontal circle (global center, radius in meters) until [param density_scale] times its density is reached where its filters allow it. Repeated calls at the same place don't add more. Returns the number of new instances.

method.name: place_instance
method.description: Places one instance of the type [param type_index] on the ground below a global position, with the placement settings of the type (without its filters). Returns [code]false[/code] outside of the landscape.

method.name: reapply
method.description: Applies the current placement settings (scale, rotation, alignment, offset) and filters of the type [param type_index] to its instances in a horizontal circle: instances that don't match the filters anymore are removed. Returns the number of changed or removed instances.

method.name: remove_foliage_type
method.description: Removes the foliage type at [param index] and its instances.

method.name: remove_instances_in_radius
method.description: Removes the instances of the type [param type_index] in a horizontal circle (a negative type index removes all types). Returns the number of removed instances.

method.name: set_foliage_type
method.description: Replaces the foliage type at [param index], keeping its instances.

method.name: set_instances_in_rect
method.description: Replaces the instances of the type [param type_index] in a rect of the landscape space by raw instances (see [method get_instances_in_rect]).

method.name: set_type_data
method.description: Replaces all the instances of the type [param type_index] by compressed data (see [method get_type_data]).

method.name: snap_to_terrain
method.description: Puts the instances in a rect of the landscape space (all of them when empty) back on the terrain.

members.member: If [code]false[/code], no level of detail casts shadows.
Size in meters of the cells (chunks) the instances are sorted into. Smaller cells are culled more precisely and switch levels of detail as a whole more often, at the cost of more draw calls.

Colors the instances for debugging and draws the bounds of the drawn cells (like [member Landscape3D.debug_view]). When the LOD of the landscape is frozen ([member Landscape3D.freeze_lod]), the foliage keeps its levels of detail too, so that they can be inspected from another point of view.
The foliage types of the instances. Use [method add_foliage_type], [method remove_foliage_type] and [method set_foliage_type] to change them while keeping the instances.
If [code]true[/code], instances are put back on the terrain (keeping their offset from the ground and adjusting their alignment) when the heights of the landscape change under them.
The instances of each foliage type, compressed (see [method get_type_data]).
Multiplies the level of detail and cull distances of all foliage types (e.g. a quality setting).
The render layers the foliage is drawn on.

constants.constant: Instances are colored by level of detail, with the colors of [constant Landscape3D.DEBUG_VIEW_LOD_LEVELS] (and of the LOD window of the editor). The bounds of the cells drawn as a whole have the color of their level, the bounds of the cells sorted per instance are white.
Instances and bounds are colored by cell (chunk).

Instances and bounds are colored by how their cell is drawn: blue when it is entirely within one level of detail and drawn as a whole, orange when it crosses a level of detail or cull distance and is sorted per instance (the cells whose updates would move to the GPU with indirect drawing).

Number of floats of an instance in the raw data of [method get_instances_in_rect]: the 3 x 4 transform in the layout of [MultiMesh] buffers, the offset from the ground, the random value and the alignment normal.
